findings.title: Bind pending routine generation to its originating item
findings.why_it_matters: Starting generation for mechanism A, then selecting existing mechanism B while the model is pending, saves A's generated plan into B and clears B's participants, runs, decisions and version history. The mechanism buttons remain active and replace the shared I variable while build awaits the request; its completion writes and persists whichever item is now selected. Retrying A does not restore the overwritten B records. The options and revision handlers have the same mutable-item completion pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Capture the originating item and a per-item request generation before each asynchronous options, build and revision request. Apply returned data only to that captured item if it is still present and that generation is current; persist S, and redraw or change steps only when I is still the originating item. Do not write a completed request into the currently selected global I or resurrect an item deleted while pending.
